svg.aria-label: PDF Zathura Keys for Obsidian: a PDF view driven by zathura's keys. J and K turn pages, 12G goes to page 12, i recolors the page dark, gg goes back to the first page, and a status bar shows the file, page and percent.

svg.text: Zathura's keys in Obsidian's PDF view:
read a book without the mouse.
